content.text: Hello! Today, we will learn how to find the **Kth Smallest Element** in a Binary Search Tree. By exploiting the properties of a BST, we can solve this problem in linear time with a very elegant solution. Let's see how!

Do you remember the properties of **Inorder Traversal** (Left → Root → Right)? When we perform Inorder traversal on a Binary Search Tree, it visits the elements in **strictly sorted ascending order**!
This observation makes our task very straightforward: to find the Kth smallest element, we perform Inorder traversal and count the elements we visit. The Kth element we process is our answer!
